Opportunities:
• Recycling - Recycling to reduce
the amount of waste that goes to
landfill and save on waste disposal
fees.
• Reducing waste - Implementing
strategies to reduce waste, such
as minimizing paper usage or
switching to reusable materials,
to save on waste disposal fees and
reduce the Bank’s environmental
impact.
• Proper waste disposal - Ensuring
waste is disposed off properly can
reduce environmental pollution
and greenhouse gas emissions,
which can lead to positive impacts
on the environment and society.
